derived_packet_fields.question: generic question template with source/target substitutions
derived_packet_fields.root_sha256: selected relation file SHA-256 from parent certificate

failure_rule: Any derivation disagreement is an integrity failure and terminates the chain fail-closed.
golden_rule: For genuinely new levels, no historical golden is available to generation, selection, Spectroscope or classification. Any later comparison material is terminal-only and cannot alter results.
no_manual_freeze_per_level: A human does not redefine each child packet. The one frozen chain policy deterministically derives it.
packet_freeze_rule: Write packet, question and execution plan atomically; canonical-hash all three; verify by a second independent derivation before any child run directory is created.
precondition: The parent certificate is ELIGIBLE_AUTO_PARENT or is the frozen L16 bootstrap certificate explicitly accepted by this Phase-0 specification.
